description: This file implements the MediaKeysCapabilities class and related factory functions for managing media key system support, including querying supported key systems and their versions, with logging and error handling.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilities
classes.description: Implements media key system support querying, including supported key systems and their versions, using provided factories and Ocdm interfaces.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with provided OcdmFactory and OcdmSystemFactory, fetching the Ocdm instance.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a list of supported key system strings by querying the Ocdm interface.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system, returning success status.
